Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.

analyst.text: Toronto beat Brooklyn behind 34 points from Scottie Barnes but missed the Cup knockouts on point differential. Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett are still out, and starter Ja'Kobe Walter left Friday's game with a quad contusion. Denver beat Utah with Jamal Murray scoring 36.
